name: Albacross
summary: IP-to-company and domain enrichment: the company behind an IPv4 address, or firmographics (industry, employees, revenue, location) for a website domain.

api_key.description: An Albacross secret API key (dashboard > Settings > API Keys). Sent as Authorization: Api-Key <key>.

notes: No match is a 204 with no body, not a 404; a malformed IP or domain is a 400.
Usage is rate-limited per key (429 when exceeded); limits are not published in the docs.
Use the secret key server-side; the public key is for the browser Reveal script with domain whitelisting.

endpoints.name: Identify the company behind an IP
endpoints.summary: Firmographics of the company an IPv4 address belongs to.

ip_address.description: Decimal IPv4 address; IPv6 is not supported.

notes: Residential, VPN and internal IPs usually return 204 (no match).

endpoints.name: Enrich a company by domain
endpoints.summary: Firmographics for a website domain: name, industry, employee count, revenue, country and more.
